candidate.publisher: Alabama Secretary of State, Business Services Division
candidate.product: Business Entity Database / Government Records Inquiry System
candidate.availability: free per-entity inquiry only; no published bulk file, API, feed, recurring export, or supported automation route
candidate.price: No bulk business-entity price is published; ad hoc public-record copies are $1 per page plus quoted outside costs

observed_evidence: The current SOS entity database exposes individual searches only; its downloads page contains filing forms rather than an entity dataset, and no recurring bulk business-entity product is priced.
A 2021 internal records authority describes the database and a few fields but is not a current export schema, sample, row count, byte size, checksum, manifest, or status codebook.
Entity ID changed from six to nine displayed digits by adding leading zeroes and is continued through at least some conversions, but universal non-reuse and lifecycle behavior remain undocumented.
Exists is legal-record status rather than operating proof, and elimination of SOS annual reports effective October 2024 increases address and status staleness risk.

The official $1,500 full and $300 weekly bulk prices apply to UCC data, not business entities; public inspection supplies no affirmative transformation, geocoding, publication, or redistribution license.

FTP delivery is possible, but full-versus-delta, deletion, correction, replay, checksum, unattended retrieval, and derived-publication rights remain undocumented.
